jobs.title: R&D AI-Native Mobile Engineer – Deployment Platform Haifa, Israel (Hybrid)
jobs.description: AI-Native Mobile Engineer - Deployment Platform | Augury About The Position You will join the Deployment Platform team, which puts Augury's technology directly in the hands of customers, field technicians, and partners. As an AI-Native mobile engineer, your primary development framework is Flutter (with native iOS and Android used when needed), building the mobile application central to Augury's field deployment. You are also comfortable across the full stack to ensure end-to-end feature delivery. Most importantly, you will shape the next generation of agentic installation experiences that define how industrial AI reaches the factory floor. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of mobile, IoT, and AI. A Day In Your Life Design, build, and maintain high-quality, cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android using the core Flutter/Dart stack. Lead the design and shipment of agentic-first workflows for guided installation, leveraging LLMs (Azure OpenAI, Gemini) to assist technicians and automate decision-making in the field. Implement complex IoT/Hardware integration features, including NFC provisioning, AR field tools, and indoor positioning/navigation. Contribute to backend and frontend services/APIs to ensure seamless, end-to-end feature delivery. Architect and maintain a scalable, modular monorepo, ensuring robustness through strong state management (BLoC/RxDart) and comprehensive test coverage. Collaborate with product and design teams to deliver exceptional UI/UX, including adaptive and RTL-aware layouts. What You Bring Agentic-First Mindset & Proven Experience as an AI-Native Engineer utilizing tools like Claude, Cursor, or Gemini to enhance productivity and quality in commercial development. 5+ years of mobile development experience with proficiency in Flutter/Dart and native iOS/Android, BLoC state management, and designing scalable mobile architecture. Comfortable with full-stack contributions to backend and frontend services/APIs to ensure end-to-end feature ownership. Proven ability to write high-quality, testable Dart code with cross-platform (iOS/Android) and RTL familiarity. Strong Advantage Experience with industrial IoT and field-service applications, including device commissioning workflows, hands-on IoT connectivity (Wi-Fi, NFC, BLE, and Beacons APIs), and familiarity with AR and Indoor Navigation. Familiarity with Firebase, third-party support tooling (Intercom), and Offline/Sync capabilities. Tech Stack Flutter, Dart, Modular Monorepos, BLoC, RxDart, Go_router, Python, Go, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, MongoDB Atlas, REST APIs, Microservices, NFC, BLE, Beacons, and WiFi. What Success Looks Like Build reusable, high-quality mobile components and architecture. Ship reliable, production-ready mobile features and enhance the user experience. Utilize the AI Native Development process in your day-to-day to improve workflows and the product. Contribute to the overall product infrastructure and backend services when mobile expertise is needed. Improve the mobile application's performance, stability, and maintainability (e.g., state management, threading, data synchronization). Contribute to practical standards around mobile architecture, testing, monitoring, security, and deployment (CI/CD). jobs.title: Sales Application Engineer United States (Remote)
jobs.description: Application Engineer | Augury About The Position As an Application Engineer, you will visit our customers or prospective customers in person to generate a Scope Of Work (SOW) by observing rotating equipment, reviewing engineering documents, engineering key Augury hardware or software applications, and helping develop the value of condition monitoring. A Day In Your Life Plan and execute site visits with customers; professionally represent Augury in the field. Work closely with Augury Sales and Engineering teams to drive SOW creation at customer sites. Walk through facilities to observe rotating machines, and design the application of hardware and software solutions to meet the needs of our customers. Write site visit reports. Manage the handoff of SOW to Sales and Implementation/Installation teams via internal tools. Effectively manage time and administrative tasks, which include, but are not limited to, service reports, customer action lists, asset lists, Salesforce, and other project management software. Train to sharpen your skillset and capabilities: Learn and research different aspects of manufacturing industries, condition monitoring technologies, reliability techniques, and maintenance, also different machines and manufacturing operations. This job requires up to 90% travel to visit sites for scope generation. What You Bring Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (preferably Chemical, Mechanical, or equivalent) or 5 years of experience working in manufacturing in Operations, Maintenance, or Reliability. Desire to work and learn in a fast paced environment. Drive: A love of cutting-edge technology, industrial businesses, and can think on your feet. You are looking for an opportunity to join a company that is changing the manufacturing industry. Superb communication skills: You love interacting live with customers and have the ability to lead technical discovery discussions at the site level of an organization. Craft questions for customers to identify the best scope of work, implementation technique, and intersect application selection with value for the customer’s organization. Must have a valid driver's license, passport, and the ability to successfully pass a background check. Residence in the US, ideally within one hour of a major airport. Able to travel internationally when required. Vibration Analyst Category I or II certification is a plus. Experience working in industrial environments is a plus. Professional presence and ability to represent Augury in the field. We offer several perks that include flexible PTO, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k) match, stock options, paid parental leave, and WFH and phone stipend. The pay range for this position in Colorado, California, and New York is a base salary of $75,000 - $95,000 This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. The pay offered may vary depending on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, and experience. After you apply, you may be invited to complete a short, asynchronous interview with June, our AI Recruitment Agent as the first step in our process. You can complete it whenever it works best for your schedule—no need to wait for a recruiter to book time with you. This helps us get to know you quickly and consistently, and ensures we can move through the hiring process efficiently while keeping things fair for every candidate. jobs.description: Director, Demand Generation | Augury About The Position As an experienced, visionary leader within the marketing organization, you will orchestrate the growth engine that fuels Augury’s global revenue pipeline. You will lead and develop a high-performing team to refine customer acquisition and expansion strategies. This is a unique opportunity to help a leading company fuel its next level of growth, including the launch of new products, segments, and positioning. You will have experience building agentic and automated pipeline strategies across multiple channels, ensuring there is alignment to reach GTM targets. This role encompasses all aspects of growth marketing: paid advertising, events, field marketing, and ABM. While supported by a team, you will set strategic direction and contribute to demand gen initiatives as needed. This role is part of the Marketing Executive Leadership Team and reports directly to the VP of Marketing. Employee must be located in eastern or central timezone. A Day In Your Life Strategic Vision and Orchestration: Cultivate and champion a sophisticated, multi-channel demand generation strategy aligned with long-term corporate objectives to ensure predictable and scalable revenue expansion. Revenue Forecasting and Fiscal Accountability : Act as the lead architect for quarterly and annual pipeline modeling to ensure the organization consistently achieves aggressive growth milestones. Leadership / Management: Guide and develop team and peers as a people leader with a commitment to professional mentorship and the scaling of high-impact marketing teams. Enterprise ABM Framework: Set the strategic direction for high-impact account engagement, guiding cross-functional teams to increase pipeline velocity to acquire net new logos and drive account expansion. Intelligence and Optimization : Synthesize complex analytics into executive-level insights to drive a culture of continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making. Global Resource Stewardship : Direct the strategic allocation of the demand-gen budget, prioritizing investments that deliver maximum impact and long-term institutional value. Operational Excellence : Promote a high-performance culture by mentoring the Marketing Operations team in the development of world-class growth and reporting infrastructure. MarTech & Analytics Governance: Select and steward the optimal marketing technology stack to enable precise attribution, comprehensive reporting, and actionable pipeline visibility, ensuring our data infrastructure scales with global growth objectives. Marketing Business Review (MBR) Leadership: Lead recurring business reviews to advocate for necessary resources, celebrate key organizational wins, and highlight progress against KPIs, ensuring continuous transparency and alignment with executive stakeholders. What You Bring Proven capability as a people leader with a commitment to professional mentorship and the scaling of high-impact marketing teams. Superior executive presence and the ability to influence at the C-suite level to align diverse stakeholders with a unified corporate vision. Strategic mastery of the B2B demand funnel, balancing long-term brand equity with immediate pipeline requirements. Expertise in the management of large-scale global budgets and the delivery of significant ROI through strategic capital allocation. A comprehensive understanding of the modern marketing technology landscape as a catalyst for organizational efficiency. Experience with cross-functional alignment, cultivating deep synergies with Sales, Product, and Finance leadership to orchestrate pipeline growth and expansion. jobs.description: Indirect Procurement Manager | Augury About The Position As an Indirect Procurement Manager, you will own sourcing strategy and execution across key indirect spend categories (e.g., SaaS, professional services, marketing, and corporate spend). You will partner closely with senior stakeholders across Finance, Legal, and business functions to drive cost efficiency, mitigate risk, and improve supplier performance. This role blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will act as a trusted advisor to the business, bringing strong commercial judgment, structured problem-solving, and data-driven insights to influence sourcing decisions and deliver measurable impact. A Day In Your Life Category Strategy & Ownership: Develop and execute sourcing strategies across assigned indirect categories, aligned with business priorities, financial goals, and risk considerations. Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with Finance, Legal, and functional leaders to translate business needs into effective sourcing strategies and drive alignment on trade-offs. Strategic Sourcing & Negotiation: Lead end-to-end sourcing initiatives, including RFPs, supplier selection, and complex negotiations that balance cost, value, flexibility, and long-term partnership. Executive Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, presenting clear, data-driven recommendations on supplier selection, pricing models, and contract structures. Supplier Management: Build and manage strategic supplier relationships, establishing performance expectations and driving accountability through regular reviews and continuous improvement. Commercial & Financial Rigor: Apply total cost of ownership (TCO) principles, benchmarking, and market intelligence to inform decisions and challenge supplier pricing and commercial models. Performance & Outcomes: Deliver measurable cost savings, cost avoidance, and process improvements across assigned categories while maintaining or improving service levels. Risk & Governance: Ensure sourcing decisions and contracts are compliant, well-documented, and aligned with internal policies and risk management standards. What You Bring Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related field 5–8+ years of experience in indirect procurement, sourcing, or category management Experience managing categories such as professional services, marketing, or similar indirect spend Proven track record of leading negotiations and delivering cost savings or efficiency improvements Strong stakeholder management experience, including working with senior leaders Experience with ERP and procurement tools (e.g., NetSuite, Coupa, or similar) Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex topics into clear business recommendations Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment Nice to Have Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company Experience building or scaling procurement processes Exposure to global suppliers and distributed teams We offer several perks that include flexible PTO, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k) match, stock options, paid parental leave, and WFH and phone stipend. jobs.description: Product Marketing Manager, Customer & Partner Marketing | Augury About The Position About the Role You will own how we grow with the customers and partners we already have. You'll turn happy customers into vocal advocates, build adoption and expansion programs that drive revenue, and extend our reach through co-marketing with strategic technology and channel partners. Your work shows up in renewal rates, expansion pipeline, customer references that close deals, and joint campaigns that open new doors. This is a great fit for a relationship-driven marketer who makes customers the hero of the story and knows how to turn partnerships into pipeline. What You'll Do Customer advocacy: Build a program spanning case studies, testimonials, video stories, and references. Keep a searchable reference pipeline so Sales always has the right proof point for the right deal. Nurture customer champions for speaking slots, advisory boards, and peer communities. Lifecycle and expansion: Design campaigns that drive onboarding, adoption, and expansion. Work with Customer Success to spot upsell and cross-sell opportunities and convert them. Report on advocacy participation, expansion influence, and retention.
